origin: the dispose check's bar tested only a fork's shape — product level, irreducible costs, the user's tie-break — and all three can be true of a fork that does not matter, so a trivial fork stopped a live walk as hard as a genuine product defect; and the Stakes line, authored by the agent proposing the fork, was what the dispose re-derived against, so a hypothetical cost carried a side past the bar unchecked. This walks the analysis loop through one such Decision: a plain webhook-guard proposal takes the auto opt-in; the staged reference Decision — support or refuse a `~`-prefixed order reference, a fork at product level whose every side leaves the user well served — is re-derived against the tree, its asserted cost to refusing found hypothetical (every reference the tree mints is `ord_` plus a ULID and no import path exists), the fork found a preference, and settled on the precedent that leans — checkout already refuses what the gateway cannot take literally — against the staged recommendation; it re-presents plain under --gate auto: auto-approved, no raise composed, no decision menu, no user turn
answers: a — approve this proposal and take the rest automatically
